description: Architect, produce to, consume from, and operate Apache Kafka event streaming systems. Use when partitioning topics for ordered processing, configuring durability invariants (acks=all, min.insync.replicas), tuning consumer groups and cooperative rebalancing, designing offset commit strategies, tracking consumer lag, integrating Schema Registries with Avro or JSON Schema, managing poison pills with dead-letter queues (DLQs), or enabling Exactly-Once Semantics (EOS).
